summary: Live-code audit found the primary genius cache exhausted except launch-confidence maintenance and the innovation pack blocked on credentials, dashboards, physical QA, human data, or a too-broad replay runner. The shippable second-order lane was the PWA install QA path: runtime prompt state existed, but no tested local receipt surfaced prompt readiness or persisted real browser outcomes.

items.title: Expose a truthful PWA install readiness receipt on HomeV2
items.why: Physical PWA install QA remains manual, but App already detects the browser beforeinstallprompt event. A pure receipt helper and HomeV2 chip make prompt readiness, standalone mode, service-worker support, and manifest presence visible without claiming device acceptance.
items.recipe: Add buildPwaInstallReceipt(), wire pwaPromptReady into HomeV2, render a PWA status chip, and cover prompt-ready/browser-ready/standalone states with tests.

L1.recipe: Unit-test a pure helper for PWA install readiness state.

L2.recipe: Render the receipt on HomeV2 and pass the App prompt state through props.

L3.recipe: Persist browser prompt outcomes as local QA evidence for later physical-device review.

items.title: Persist accepted/dismissed browser install prompt outcomes locally
items.why: The browser userChoice result is real QA evidence, but it was previously discarded after clearing the deferred prompt. Persisting accepted/dismissed outcomes gives later manual QA a receipt while still requiring standalone relaunch before saying the PWA is fully installed.
items.recipe: Add build/load/save PWA install attempt helpers, write them from promptInstallApp(), and render stored accepted/dismissed outcomes in HomeV2.

L1.recipe: Persist the prompt outcome in localStorage.

L2.recipe: Fold the stored outcome into the HomeV2 receipt and focused tests.

L3.recipe: After real device QA, add a manual export receipt tied to docs/QA_CHECKLIST.md.

items.title: Regenerate the innovation pack and keep blocked items honestly deferred
items.why: The regenerated innovation pack contains Supabase/analytics credential gates, dashboard allowlists, manual physical/browser QA, human Lighthouse/funnel data, a product membership decision, and a full replay runner that still needs stored trace payload design. Treating those as blocked is more valuable than forcing code that would lie about trust or evidence.
items.recipe: Record the deferrals and avoid changing replay labels, screenshot provenance, or analytics/account promises without the missing evidence.

skipped.reason: Verified as real but too broad for an honest same-session change without stored trace payload design and narrowed enemy/physics parity slices. Advisory replay language remains correct.
Verified as real but blocked on browser-captured boss, build/debrief, and leaderboard screenshots. Metadata-only changes would fabricate provenance.
Credential/dashboard gated; check-secrets and blocker preflight still classify analytics as missing or owner-dashboard work.

executionLog.notes: Added pure PWA readiness receipt helper, HomeV2 chip, App prompt-ready prop, and focused tests.
Persisted browser prompt accepted/dismissed outcomes and rendered stored acceptance without claiming standalone install completion.
Regenerated docs/INNOVATION_PACK.md; remaining candidates are credential, dashboard, manual, data, product-decision, or broad replay-design gates.
